en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘When the owned slave is blinded, so there is no slavery upon him; and the slave, when he is suffers from leprosy, so there is no slavery upon him’.
